title.narrative: Multitranche Financing Facility (MFF) - Rajasthan Urban Sector Development Investment Program (Tranche 1)

description.narrative: To increase economic growth, reduce poverty and sustain improvement in the urban environment and quality of life in the Jaisalmer, Alwar and Jhalawar/Jhalarapatan. The expected outcome of the Tranche 1 will be increased access to sustainable urban infrastructure and services for people in the Project ULBs, and improved capacities of, and sustainable management of urban services by the Project ULBs.

title.narrative: 29 Jun 2018 | Project Result / Case Study: https://www.adb.org/results/flushing-out-growth-india-s-desert-state
Loan 2366: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024

Progress Toward Outcome: One railway over bridge, one STP and two MSW landfill site has been completed. Actions towards achieving the outcome are underway as explained further in the status of implementation progress of outputs below.
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Sep 2016: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//40031-013-rpddr-01.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Aug 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/40031/40031-053-smr-en_1.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Water Supply - 335 km of pipelines laid
Sewerage and Sanitation - 98 km of sewer network laid, construction of one STP completed.
Solid Waste Management - Two MSW landfill site constructed.
Urban Transport - Construction of one railway over bridge completed.
